messages:
ashley: quick async standup — api-gateway / routing / auth / rate-limits
- yesterday: rolled out route rewrite for /v2 -> /api/v2, smoke looked OK
- blockers: intermittent 503s from canary in eu-west under burst > 1k rps, spiky latencies ~200-300ms
- today: triage canary, inspect rate-limit token-bucket behavior, check fallback pool sizing and runbook updates

ben: what's the canary id and any quick reproducer?

ashley: canary id gw-canary-2026-03, first seen ~09:40 UTC. pattern: 429 spikes then cascade to 503 on some requests. quick reproducer below.

ben: paste the snippet?

ashley:
```bash
for i in {1..2000}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -H "X-Client-Id: test-canary" https://gw.redwood.dev/api/v2/ingest &
sleep 0.001
done
```

mira: looking at metrics — shard-3 token-bucket shows short depletion windows, we see bursts of 429 then fallback to secondary pool which has lower mem and hits timeouts -> 503. investigating batching config and kv-cache pressure.

jordan: fyi I rolled a tiny change to kv-cache fallback in PR #4827 that might alter behavior under burst; tagging @ashley in case it overlapped with the canary.

sam: linked PR: https://git.redwood.co/r/redwood/gw/pull/4827 — will queue review, it's a small delta.

lee: quick note — saw a flaky unit test on gw-rate-limiter that times out intermittently; filed issue #133, could be related to test timing assumptions.

ashley: immediate ask: can someone with infra perms bump the secondary pool mem from 4GB -> 8GB for the canary ring? might stop the 503 cascade while we root cause. cc @ben @mira

ben: I can do that in ~10m. will patch infra template and trigger canary redeploy. :thumbsup:

mira: and while you're at it, flip `route_priority` for the ingest route to prefer primary for 1m so we avoid immediate fallback during the ramp.

ben: done — updated infra template, deploying to gw-canary-2026-03. deploy-bot will post status.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for gw-canary-2026-03 by ben. image: gw:sha-abcdef, target: canary ring
deploy-bot: Health checks: 20/20 passing, traffic ramp to 10% complete

ashley: re-running the repro now. will monitor latency and paste summary after ~5m.

sam: I'll start the PR review, expect comments in ~30m. also adding a unit test for token-bucket edge-case during bursts.

lee: test issue: https://issues.redwood.dev/133 — I can take a look and attempt a flake fix after lunch.

ashley: update (5m): latency stabilized, no 503s in last 3m, 429s reduced. :relieved:

jordan: great. can we add an instrumentation alert for token-bucket depletion > 5s within a minute? thoughts on threshold?

mira: propose alert: `token_bucket_depletion_count > 10` per minute for any shard -> page on-call. I'll add to alerting playbook and include remediation steps (bump pool, flip route_priority, short-term throttling).

ben: confirming canary stable, will promote the infra change to next staging batch after PR merges.

ashley: blockers cleared for now. i'll follow up with canary postmortem notes and update runbooks + onboarding doc for canary troubleshooting. thanks team :shipit:

sam: ping me when PR is ready for final review. :eyes:

lee: i'll pick up the unit test flake this afternoon.

ashley: closing this check-in — please drop any async notes here if anything else pops up.
